checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "Drum Machine", a grid of 16 cells in a single row, the text "Tempo: 120", and the button "Play".
Clicking the cell labelled "Step 1" changes its background to a filled state and shows the text "Pattern: 1" below the grid.
Clicking the cell labelled "Step 5" changes its background to a filled state and updates the text to "Pattern: 1, 5".
Clicking the cell labelled "Step 1" again removes the fill and updates the text to "Pattern: 5".
Typing "140" in the field labelled "Tempo" and pressing Enter updates the text to "Tempo: 140".
With "Step 1" and "Step 5" active, clicking the button "Play" changes the button text to "Stop" and starts the audio loop; after 2 seconds, clicking "Stop" changes the button text back to "Play".
Pressing the key "1" while the grid has focus activates the cell labelled "Step 1" and shows "Pattern: 1".
Pressing the key "5" while the grid has focus activates the cell labelled "Step 5" and shows "Pattern: 1, 5".
Reload keeps the pattern: with "Step 1" and "Step 5" active and Tempo "140", reloading the page still shows "Tempo: 140" and "Pattern: 1, 5".
